'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Josh Mack DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Remaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
